ref: Ke hoach dev iOS+macOS theo yeu cau moi da viet xong: docs/DEV_PLAN_IOS_MACOS_TOC_DO.md (commit 61582c0, nhanh main). Doc kem docs/YEU_CAU_TOC_DO_ON_DINH.md (yeu cau goc: may trang thai START/RAMP/STABLE/PROBE/DEGRADED, moc 8 Mbps duy tri 10 phut, tieu chi A1-A6) va docs/VERSIONING.md. KET LUAN QUAN TRONG: huong ramp hien tai cua iOS/macOS (HysteriaBandwidthControl + rebuildTransportForBandwidth, rampMaxAttempts=5) SAI theo §3.1 cua yeu cau - nang so khai Brutal KHONG lam tang toc do tai (server bat ignoreClientBandwidth; do that khai 3,8 Mbps van tai 35 Mbps). Ramp phai lam bang DUONG + NODE. VIEC LAM DUOC NGAY (khong phu thuoc 3 cau hoi cho chu du an): P0-1 merge nhanh mac/parity-1.4.1 (LivenessWatchdog + vong 15s) vao main va chinh nguong theo A5 (im >=15s VA bat doi xung, tu dung lai toi da 3 lan 2/5/10s roi moi teardownAndCancel + TUNNEL_NO_TRAFFIC); P0-2 viet 2 file THUAN LOGIC co unit test: TransportLadder.swift (thang bac: QUIC/UDP truc tiep -> TCP relay -> WS relay node khac) va GoodputMeter (cua so truot 12s/mau 1s tren utunPacketCounters da co o HysteriaPacketTunnelProvider.swift:526-537); P1-1 ra 2 loi nho: state/message lech UI (nhu Android tung bi 'Connected' + 'Reconnecting...') va 16 KB page size cho libwg-go.a + framework Hysteria (otool -l | grep -A3 LC_SEGMENT_64; neu 4KB thi build lai gomobile/Go voi -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384). CHO CHOT (3 cau hoi o §7 ke hoach) truoc khi lam may trang thai + kenh do: (1) chinh sach khi het duong - khong ro ri (gói bi chan, khach thay mat mang) hay closeTun() nhu Android (khong mat mang nhung di thang ra nha mang, KHONG qua VPN); (2) moc 8 Mbps khi mang goc thap hon 8 thi giu STABLE o muc thap nhat dat duoc; (3) co duoc nang cap sang NODE khac khong (anh huong quota + IP thoat cua khach). PHU THUOC: wsrelay phai khoe truoc (yeu cau §3.3-3.4: cau WS chet sau 11-19 ping, hoi 50-65s) - viec server, da co T-20260922-09.
